transcript: A video won't rescue a weak page. But a good explainer, placed well and described properly, can help your page get found.
Search engines want pages that answer the question. A clear explainer helps, and it can show up in video results and on YouTube. But it never guarantees a ranking boost.
Put each explainer on the page whose topic it explains, and place it where people see it. A video buried at the bottom is easy to miss.
Search engines read text, not pictures. Give the video a descriptive title, and tidy your speaker notes into a short transcript below it.
Add video structured data, or check your platform does. Keep the page fast with sensible hosting, and use captions and a transcript together.
Your sales deck already explains the topic. On Pro, a.i. directs the video, tightening the story and designing each scene. Try Basic first at powerpoint2vid.com.
